Based on the screenshot and the style of these posts, I have a few observations:

- The headline ("Trump's new plan could retire every 9-5er on August 23rd") is classic engagement-bait. These videos almost always build suspense and then direct viewers toward a specific cryptocurrency or trading platform.
- I couldn't find any credible announcement from Trump or the White House about a cryptocurrency event on August 23 that would "retire every 9-to-5 worker." citeturn0search1turn0search2
- Similar videos using Trump's image to promote crypto have frequently been identified as misleading or outright scams, sometimes using AI-generated audio or edited clips. citeturn0search0

If I had to guess based on what's trending in this niche, the video is most likely trying to funnel viewers into one of these:
- Bitcoin (BTC)
- XRP (Ripple)
- $TRUMP (the Trump-themed memecoin)
- A brand-new "insider" token that the creator claims will explode

But I don't want to guess when we can know for sure.
